caption:
What's your goal for today's study session? Be specific.

Not "do some math." One skill, a number of questions, a difficulty, and what counts as done. Write it at the top before you start.

Comment today's goal.
tiktok_caption: Set one specific SAT study goal before every session.

youtube.title: SAT Study Tip: Set One Specific Goal Per Session
youtube.description: Start every SAT study session with one written goal: one skill, a question count, a difficulty level, and a clear finish line.
